name.ro: Bilet valabil 60 minute prin aplicația 24pay, cursele spre Arcuș
name.hu: 60 percig érvényes jegy a 24pay alkalmazásban, árkosi járatokra

note: Only the base 24pay single fare is modelled here; the engine's fareFor() picks the first ticket per zone. The Multi-Trans fare card dated 2026-02-01 confirms the 2.5 lei city price and lists more single-trip options not modelled: ticket machine 2.5, from the driver 5.0, 2-trip 5.0; plus passes (monthly all-lines 84, means-tested pensioner passes, free student passes). The card still prints 45 min for the 24pay ticket, but the owner (firsthand, reliable) says validity is 50 min city / 60 min Arcuș as of ~Aug 2026 - keep 50/60. Arcuș is a separate commune, so line 10 crosses a fare boundary: a city ticket cannot board line 10, an Arcuș ticket can transfer onto the city buses. City ticket also covers Coșeni/Szotyor, Chilieni/Kilyén and Câmpu Frumos/Szépmező. Șugaș Băi is treated as city because the resort belongs to Sfântu Gheorghe, unconfirmed.
